name: HNS_PERSONS
description: HNS PERSONS. This table stores Owner / Person related data. The column Type signifies type of activity (Incident, Investigation or Action).

columns.name: EMPLOYEE_ID
columns.description: EMPLOYEE_ID column : Employee ID of the owner.

columns.name: PERSON_ASSIGN_ID
columns.description: PERSON_ASSIGN_ID column : Assignment ID of the owner.

columns.name: ROLE_CODE
columns.description: Role ID assigned to the person.

columns.name: TARGET_COMPLETION_DATE
columns.description: Target completion date for the task assigned to the person.

columns.name: ACTUAL_COMPLETION_DATE
columns.description: Actual completion date of the task  assigned to the person.

columns.name: COMPLETED_FLAG
columns.description: Completed flag. Signifies whether the task is completed

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Deleted flag. Signifies whether the task assigned is deleted

columns.name: TASK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Task Type identifier. Lookup to the Task Type FND lookup.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Unique person identifier. This is the system generated primary key for HNS_PERSONS table.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: RESULT_CODE
columns.description: Result Code Column : Incident Owner check result code.

columns.name: ACTION_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Action Required Flag Column : Check box to confirm whether an action is required.
